messages:
maria: quick question — do we want the new routing policy to live on the edge proxy or as a control-plane-only rule?
ajay: leaning toward control-plane. eases rollout and testing, but we need a cheap enforcement path at the edge for quotas.
sophia: agreed. for latency-sensitive routes, a hop to control-plane could add variability. what if we push a lightweight eval to edge and fallback to control-plane for heavy checks?
kevin: that sounds like hybrid. edge enforces soft-quotas (fast reject), control-plane does authoritative accounting and telemetry.
maria: hybrid could work. need to define how we handle mismatches (edge allows but control-plane denies). fallbacks must be deterministic for clients.
ajay: proposal: edge maintains a token-bucket with config from control-plane (periodic diff). control-plane streams updates and reconciles counters. on mismatch, control-plane decision wins and we signal a 429 with header X-RW-Quota-Decision.
sophia: UI question — how will this show up in Console? product wants per-route quota heatmap + diff between edge and control-plane.
maria: Console should show both telemetry streams side-by-side: edge vs control-plane, plus a reconciliation rate metric. add a flag to surface routes with >1% mismatch.
kevin: telemetry volume concern. streaming per-request deltas from edge is expensive. instead send aggregated deltas every 10s and send anomalies immediately.
ajay: agree, sample plan: aggregates at 10s windows, anomalies (error spikes, overruns) get immediate event. we should also include a small histogram of latency distribution for quota checks.
sophia: rollouts UX: we need canary policy toggles per-route. engineers should be able to target a canary by tag (team/nginx-v2) and see expected vs measured allowed rate.
maria: workflow: 1) create policy in control-plane 2) enable canary (10% by tag) 3) monitor reconciliation + mismatch heatmap 4) promote -> full. console shows a single-button promote + rollback.
kevin: ops ask: how do we test this end-to-end in staging? recommend a traffic replay job that can toggle the policy bucket sizes and surface reconciliation.
ajay: also need a small compatibility shim for services that talk REST vs gRPC. policy control-plane should expose both gRPC admin API and a REST JSON endpoint for Console + partners.
sophia: protobuf first, auto-generate REST via transcoding for common clients. keep the canonical schema in proto.
maria: sounds good. action items: ajay to draft token-bucket sync proto + REST schema, kevin to prototype edge shim (10s aggregator + anomaly event), sophia to mock Console panels for reconciliation/canary UX.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: policy-service/staging v0.12.0 at 2025-06-15T18:00Z (will run canary tests). :rocket:
maria: thanks, team. let's sync tomorrow 10am to review drafts.
